body.name: \mathcal P_{\mathcal S,H,L}^{+}\text{ and }\mathcal N_{\delta}(p^{\star})
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal S,H,L}^{+}=\{p\in\operatorname{relint}\Delta(\{0,1\}^{\mathcal W_H}):\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p)\ne\varnothing\}\), and for \(\delta>0\), \(\mathcal N_{\delta}(p^{\star})=\{p\in\mathcal P_{\mathcal S,H,L}^{+}:\|p-p^{\star}\|_{\infty}<\delta\}\).
